_comment: Detection rules used by the scanner modules. Edit this file to tune detection without touching code.
_suid_review_recommended_note: Not dangerous by default, but these legacy remote-shell tools are rarely needed on a modern system. Left OUT of known_normal on purpose so the scanner still flags them as MEDIUM for the analyst to confirm they're actually required.

capability_dangerous.cap_setuid: Can change its user ID (become root).
capability_dangerous.cap_dac_read_search: Can read any file, ignoring permissions.
capability_dangerous.cap_sys_admin: Very broad administrative power (close to root).
capability_dangerous.cap_sys_ptrace: Can inspect and modify other processes.
capability_dangerous.cap_chown: Can change ownership of any file.

kernel_cves.name: Dirty Pipe
kernel_cves.note: Local privilege escalation via a page-cache overwrite bug. Patched in 5.16.11, 5.15.25, 5.10.102.

kernel_cves.name: Dirty COW
kernel_cves.note: Race condition in copy-on-write handling allowing write access to read-only mappings.

kernel_cves.name: OverlayFS LPE
kernel_cves.note: Missing permission check in the OverlayFS filesystem allows privilege escalation.

_kernel_cves_disclaimer: This is a small static reference list for demonstration, not a live feed. A production version should query a maintained source such as the NVD API.
